# Foreign model tasks

HuggingFace task families a published checkpoint can be loaded as, selected with ``--model-task``. Each entry pairs the ``Auto*`` class that loads the weights with the Praxis wrapper that supplies the objectives for that task.

Namespace: ``registry.namespace("model_tasks")``, declared in ``praxis.models`` (1 entries)

Selected with ``--model-task`` (default: ``causal_lm``).

## `causal_lm`

Next-token prediction. The published model supplies hidden states and logits; Praxis
supplies the criterion, the regularizers, the task weighter and the forward-path RL
policies.
